  (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ)) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime]
  (hP : P = RingHom.ker (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation x p0 hp0).toRingHom)
  (hQ : Q = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval 0).toRingHom)
  (hQP : Q = Ideal.comap (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom P) (hIQ : I ≤ Q)
  (G H : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJac : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))))
  (hsource :
    Ideal.map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ)
          (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.comap (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) P)))
        J =
      Ideal.span
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ)
              (Localization.AtPrime
                (Ideal.comap (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) P)))
            (G i)))
  (htarget :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i)))
  (hH0 : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval 0) (H i) = 0)
  (hHD :
    ∀ (i : Fin c) (j : Fin r ⊕ Fin c),
      (MvPolynomial.eval 0) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (H i)) = if j = Sum.inr i then 1 else 0)
  (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
  (hlo :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) J ^ e ≤
      Ideal.map (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom I)
  (hhi :
    Ideal.map (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom I ≤
      Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) J)
  (hunram :
    (LinearStudy.generalPointLocalQuotientPullback I
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) J) P Q
        (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom hQP hhi).FormallyUnramified)
  (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c) :
  have ψ := LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap x G hG hJac;
  have Jf := Ideal.map ψ (Ideal.span (Set.range p));
  have Θ := Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (p (Sum.inr i));
  Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c ⧸ Jf)) = Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk Jf) (ψ Θ)} ∧
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk Jf) (ψ Θ) ≠ 0

LinearStudy.projective_iterates_whole_fibers_actual_local_maps {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ r ≤ n,
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r ∧
      Module.finrank (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) Ω[MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal⁄ℂ] = r ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          let F := f.iterate k;
          let B := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal;
          let A := Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator F V);
          have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap F V ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ x0 hx0;
          ∃ p ∉ V.affineIdeal,
            (∀ (P : PrimeSpectrum A),
                φ ((Ideal.Quotient.mk V.affineIdeal) p) ∉ P.asIdeal →
                  P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ A ∧
                    PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.toRingHom P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ B ∧ P ∈ Algebra.unramifiedLocus B A) ∧
              (∃ y, LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval y) p ≠ 0) ∧
                ∀ (y : Fin n → ℂ) (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet),
                  (MvPolynomial.eval y) p ≠ 0 →
                    LinearStudy.ProjectiveWholeAmbientFiberConclusion F V y hy r ∧
                      LinearStudy.ProjectiveCenteredNormalTargetConclusion V y r ∧
                        LinearStudy.ProjectiveWholeFiberLocalMapConclusion F V ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ x0 hx0 y

      (MvPolynomial.eval fun j => (MvPolynomial.eval ↑x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X j))) (E (G x i)) = 0)
  (hJac :
    ∀ (x : ↑(MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal f V y))),
      IsUnit
        (Matrix.det fun i j =>
          (MvPolynomial.eval fun k => (MvPolynomial.eval ↑x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X k)))
            ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (E (G x i)))))
  (hs :
    ∀ (x : ↑(MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal f V y))),
      let P := RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval ↑x).toRingHom;
      Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime P)) V.affineIdeal =
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime P)) (G x i)))
  (H : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (hH0 : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval 0) (H i) = 0)
  (hHD :
    ∀ (i : Fin c) (j : Fin r ⊕ Fin c),
      (MvPolynomial.eval 0) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (H i)) = if j = Sum.inr i then 1 else 0)
  (ht :
    have z := M⁻¹.mulVec (y ∘ ⇑b.symm);
    have I :=
      Ideal.map (LinearStudy.polynomialTranslation z).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
        (Ideal.map (LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
          (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ b).toRingEquiv.toRingHom V.affineIdeal));
    let Q := RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval 0).toRingHom;
    I ≤ Q ∧
      Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I =
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i))) :
  have z := M⁻¹.mulVec (y ∘ ⇑b.symm);
  have p0 := E (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0));
  have p := fun j => E (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms (b.symm j).succ));
  have pC := fun i => (MvPolynomial.aeval p) (M⁻¹.toMvPolynomial i) - MvPolynomial.C (z i) * p0;

  have Θ := Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (pC (Sum.inr i));
  Module.Finite ℂ A ∧
    ∀ (x : ↑(MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal f V y))),
      have x' := fun j => (MvPolynomial.eval ↑x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X j));
      ∃ q,
        (x' = fun i => q ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range pC))) (MvPolynomial.X i))) ∧
          have t :=
            (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker q.toRingHom)))
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range pC))) Θ);
          Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker q.toRingHom))) = Ideal.span {t} ∧ t ≠ 0

LinearStudy.projective_iterates_whole_fibers_common_jacobian_socles {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)

  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)

    Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (MvPolynomial σ K ⧸ I)) = Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Θ}) :

    (∀ (x : ↑(MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K I)), lam x ≠ 0) ∧

        Θ.totalDegree + F.totalDegree < (n + 1) * (q - 1) → ∑ x, lam x * (MvPolynomial.eval ↑x) F = 0

LinearStudy.projective_exists_linear_projection_reduced_rank_fibers {n : ℕ}
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) :
  ∃ r P,
    r ≤ n ∧
      P ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree = r ∧
          (∃ N, ∀ m > N, Polynomial.eval (↑m) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal m)) ∧
            ∃ L,
              (∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1) ∧
                Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L) ∧
                  (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite ∧
                    (∀ (v : LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n),
                        v ≠ 0 →
                          (∀ H ∈ V.ideal.toIdeal, (MvPolynomial.eval v) H = 0) →
                            (fun i => (MvPolynomial.eval v) (L i)) ≠ 0) ∧
                      let R := MvPolynomial (Fin (r + 1)) ℂ;
                      let A := LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n ⧸ V.ideal.toIdeal;
                      have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L;
                      ∃ c,
                        c ≠ 0 ∧
                          (∃ w, (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0) ∧
                            ∀ (w : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ),
                              (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0 →
                                w 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                  Module.Finite ℂ (TensorProduct R ℂ A) ∧
                                    IsReduced (TensorProduct R ℂ A) ∧
                                      Module.finrank ℂ (TensorProduct R ℂ A) = Module.finrank R A ∧
                                        Nat.card (TensorProduct R ℂ A →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ) = Module.finrank R A

nodes.formalType:
LinearStudy.projective_iterates_simultaneous_whole_point_fiber_relations {n : ℕ}
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree)
  (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints) (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥)
  (x0 : Fin n → ℂ) (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ r P,
    r ≤ n ∧
      P ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree = r ∧
          ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r ∧
            (∃ N, ∀ j > N, Polynomial.eval (↑j) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal j)) ∧
              ∃ L,
                (∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1) ∧
                  Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L) ∧
                    (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite ∧
                      ∃ d,
                        0 < d ∧
                          ↑d = ↑r.factorial * P.leadingCoeff ∧
                            ∀ (k : ℕ),
                              0 < r →
                                1 < (f.iterate k).degree →
                                  ∃ c,
                                    c ≠ 0 ∧
                                      (∃ w, (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0) ∧
                                        ∀ (w : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ),
                                          (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0 →
                                            w 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                              Nat.card ↑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearSection V L w) = d ∧
                                                ∀ z ∈ LinearStudy.projectiveLinearSection V L w,
                                                  Projectivization.rep z 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                    let y := fun i =>
                                                      Projectivization.rep z i.succ / Projectivization.rep z 0;
                                                    ∃ (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet),
                                                      LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y = z ∧
                                                        Nat.card
                                                              ↑((f.iterate k).onPoints ⁻¹'
                                                                  {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y}) =
                                                            (f.degree ^ k) ^ r ∧
                                                          let S :=
                                                            (f.iterate k).onPoints ⁻¹'
                                                              {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y};
                                                          ∃ (hS : S.Finite),
                                                            ∀ (v : ↑S → LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n)
                                                              (hv : ∀ (x : ↑S), v x ≠ 0),
                                                              (∀ (x : ↑S), Projectivization.mk ℂ (v x) ⋯ = ↑x) →
                                                                ∃ weights,
                                                                  (∀ (x : ↑S), weights x ≠ 0) ∧
                                                                    ∀ (σ : LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n),
                                                                      MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous σ
                                                                          (r * ((f.iterate k).degree - 1) - 1) →
                                                                        ∑ x, weights x * (MvPolynomial.eval (v x)) σ = 0
